<h2>Watch series for free</h2>
<p>If you’re looking to watch TV series for free online, there are a selection of ad-supported streaming services that don’t charge a subscription fee. Platforms like <a href="https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/tubi-tv">Tubi</a>, <a href="https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/pluto-tv">Pluto TV</a>, and <a href="https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/freevee">Freevee</a> all host a variety of entertaining free series that can be streamed online. Most of these free streaming services don’t require you to sign up for an account. Instead, they show short adverts at different intervals, making the streaming experience much more like traditional TV.</p>
<p>You can also discover what series are available for free online by using the price filter on JustWatch. Discover free series across all genres, or swap your search to find free movies if that’s what you’re after.</p>
